trust_decision.summary: An archive-supplied symlink linkname is trusted whenever path.resolve lexically collapses its '..' segments inside the output dir, so a linkname that traverses an in-output symlink (a -> '.', b -> 'a/../secret.txt') passes the check but is then created by symlink() pointing outside the output dir.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'path traversal via symlink chain'; the only symlink-target containment check is ensureLinkTargetInsideOutput, which a reader inspects before the symlink creation branch at index.js:189-192.

fix_sites.entry_point: decompress(input, output, options) with an entry of type 'symlink'
decompress(input, output, options) — scheduling of every entry type
decompress(input, output, options) — Windows symlink emulated as a hardlink

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Relative symlinks whose target does not exist yet inside the output must still be created (dangling in-output symlinks are supported, and relative links to existing in-output files must keep resolving); a fix that requires the linkname target to realpath successfully, or that realpaths the raw linkname without appending the missing tail, breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: relative linkname containing an in-output symlink component followed by '..' (a/../secret.txt)
absolute linkname (handled by the path.isAbsolute(linkname) branch in the fix)
linkname whose target is missing/dangling at check time (resolveMaybeMissing keeps the nonexistent tail)
ordering: the symlink named in the linkname is created by another entry of the same archive

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A hardlink sink that passes the raw entry.linkname to link() instead of the lexically resolved target would have the same chain problem.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Hardlink entries already flow through the same helper; a maintainer adding relative-hardlink support could reuse the raw linkname the way the symlink branch does.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second platform-specific symlink-emulation branch with its own base-directory resolution and no deferred assertion.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The branch already exists and was edited by the published fix, so a copy of the link handling there is natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second extraction path (e.g. streaming or resume/re-extract) that reuses symlink creation without the staged files-then-symlinks ordering and post-pass assertion.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The package owns all writing logic while formats are delegated to plugins, so a new orchestrator would copy the write/link code.

O10_build.project_tests: ava suite in test.js; traversal/symlink cases at test.js:70-73, 126-136, 163-167 and 182-236 with fixtures under fixtures/; run via npm test (xo + ava) or npm run test-ci

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Realpath the lexically resolved target (or reject dangling targets) inside ensureLinkTargetInsideOutput: it still never sees the raw linkname's symlink component, or it breaks legitimate dangling in-output symlinks.
